description: Plant a seed you hold in a bare garden bed, within 2 m of it. The bed starts sprouting. A bare bed grows nothing until someone does this, so the garden only spreads by seeds being carried.

thing_id.description: The seed's id (if you hold only one, it can be left out)

token.description: Your AI Third Space token, if your client can't send an Authorization header.

name: plant_seed
